title: Single-complex normalization of the scalar/geometric comparison
statement: Let R and S be coefficient families of commutative ring sheaves on every small pro-etale scheme site, with inverse-image coefficient identifications, and let a:R→S be compatible with these identifications [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. Let g:U→V be a scheme morphism. Write F,H,G,K for geometric R pullback, scalar extension on U, scalar extension on V, and geometric S pullback, respectively; use their ordinary and derived functors [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Let gamma:G₀K₀≅F₀H₀ be the inverse left-adjoint uniqueness comparison of the ordinary composite adjunctions, with right comparison identity on direct-image sections [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. Let theta=(scalarPull a g)^{-1}:GK≅FH [def-sp-coefficient-mate-comparisons]. Let q denote localization and cF,cH,cG,cK the canonical complex computation counits. For every unbounded complex P of R_V-modules, theta_(qP);H(cF(P));cH(F₀P)=K(cG(P));cK(G₀P);q(gamma_P). No flatness of P or of a is assumed, and no tensor model occurs.

proof.text: First extend the scalar derived-adjunction unit normalization from K-flat complexes to all cochain complexes: construct the normalized adjunction by the existing resolving-class derived-adjunction theorem, use its unit equation on every homotopy representative, and identify it with pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction by the existing uniqueness clause. The geometric normalization is the derived-unit factorization for the exact module pullback. Naturality then gives the normalized Hom equations for all four cochain adjunctions.

Apply normalizedAdjunction_composition to geometric R pullback followed by scalar extension on U, and to scalar extension on V followed by geometric S pullback. The ordinary uniqueness comparison has the required cochain unit equation degree by degree. The normalized derived restriction/direct-image comparison gives the right-comparison compatibility after cancelling the exact restriction factorization isomorphisms. Apply normalizedAdjunction_uniqueness to obtain compatibility of scalarPull.hom with the two composite computation counits. Precompose by scalarPull.inv and postcompose by the localized ordinary cochain comparison; cancel the two isomorphism identities to obtain the stated formula. No computation counit for scalar extension is inverted.

proof_origin.note: Proved by normalized Hom equations and adjoint uniqueness, using two completed supporting normalization modules; no additional sorry obligations.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarPull_complex_normalization
    {R S : Coefficients.{u}} (a : Change R S)
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (g : U ⟶ V)
    (P : CochainComplex (pbcModules V (R.ring V)) ℤ) :
    (scalarPull a g).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
      (pbcDerivedExtend (a.map U)).map
        ((proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors g (R.ring V) (R.ring U)
          (R.pull g)).hom.app P) ≫
      pbcComplexCounit (a.map U)
        (((proEtaleRingModulePullback g (R.ring V) (R.ring U)
          (R.pull g)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
    (pull S g).map (pbcComplexCounit (a.map V) P) ≫
      (proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors g (S.ring V) (S.ring U)
        (S.pull g)).hom.app (((pbcExtend (a.map V)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((scalarPullComplex a g).hom.app P)
